away.summary: The Devils (8-5-0) are on a road trip following a 5-2 loss to the Colorado Avalanche on Wednesday. They acquired Connor Hellebuyck from Winnipeg on Oct. 23, and he made a strong debut with 17 saves in a 5-1 win over Dallas on Tuesday. Jake Allen is listed as the backup in the projected lineup.

home.summary: The Golden Knights (9-4-1) are expected to dress the same skaters from their 4-1 victory over Ottawa on Tuesday. Carter Hart's status for Friday remains unclear despite participating in the morning skate, while Victor Olofsson practiced in a noncontact jersey. Adin Hill is projected to start in goal with Cameron Whitehead as backup.
